name: Cafe Langine

location.address: Dadman Blvd, No. 36, Shahrak Gharb, Tehran

media.alt: Dining hall at Cafe Langine on Dadman Boulevard

description: A two-floor cafe-restaurant on Dadman Boulevard with a Western food and bar menu, unhurried breakfast service, and space for about 60 guests. More of a full sit-down meal spot than a quick coffee stop, with decent parking nearby.
